title: Enterprise compliance switches: IP allowlist, sharing lock, and export gating
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Add a cohesive set of admin-facing compliance toggles (IP allowlist enforcement, global sharing lock to prevent public share links, and strict data export gating) that integrate with RBAC v2, emit audit logs for all changes and enforcement decisions, and respect SSO/SAML org-level bindings. This ticket implements backend APIs, console controls, and audit/schema changes needed to ship toggles to enterprise accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can enable/disable IP allowlisting per-organization via console and API
When IP allowlist is enabled, requests from non-allowed IPs are rejected with 403 and an audit log entry is created
Global sharing lock prevents creation of public share links and surfaces existing public resources for remediation
Data export controls block/export-approval workflow: exports to external cloud storage or email require an allowlist or explicit admin approval
All toggle flips, policy changes, and enforcement decisions produce structured audit logs (actor, timestamp, before/after, rule id)
Toggle state is honored by Dedicated and Private deployments via config sync / policy bundle
Rolling upgrade path and feature flagging to safely enable for pilot customers before org-wide rollout
design_notes: Single source of truth: store compliance toggles in new org_policy table keyed by org_id and policy_name
Policy evaluation happens as a middleware in the edge routing layer to minimize latency for enforcement decisions
RBAC v2 integration: only org admins (role: org_admin) and security managers may flip toggles; actions recorded in audit log with role context
SAML/SSO attributes: map IDP groups to RBAC roles. Enforce policy only after user identity assertion completes;
Audit logs must be JSON lines with fields: actor_id, actor_email, org_id, action, policy_name, old_value, new_value, ip, user_agent, request_id
UI: admin console shows a compliance hub with toggle state, effective scope (org/project), last changed by, and quick remediation checklist
implementation_notes: Database: add org_policies(org_id, policy_name, value, updated_by, updated_at, source)
API: POST /orgs/:org_id/policies to set policy, GET /orgs/:org_id/policies to read
Edge middleware: evaluate IP allowlist early and return standardized rejection payload; add header X-Redwood-Policy-Denied for diagnostics
Export gating flow: create export_request records and integration with approval service; blocked exports return 423 status with approval link
Audit changes: extend existing audit ingestion pipeline (kinesis -> processing) to accept new policy events and index them in the audit-log service
Dedicated/Private: add policy sync agent that pulls org policies from control plane via signed JWT and enforces locally
rollout_plan: Phase 0: behind experimental feature flag for internal orgs and engineering-only accounts
Phase 1: pilot enable for 3 enterprise customers with SRE on-call and canned rollback playbook
Phase 2: open to all enterprise accounts via console toggle; default off for new orgs
Phase 3: GA with docs, migration guide, and API contract stability guarantee
Rollback: previous policy store retained; toggles revert to prior values and sync agent supports fast pull
test_plan: Unit tests for policy store CRUD and RBAC checks
Integration tests for edge middleware rejecting out-of-range IPs and logging events
E2E tests for export workflow including approval and denial paths
Load test: enabling IP allowlist with high request QPS to ensure <2ms median added latency
Security review: threat model completed and SSO/SAML assertion tampering tests included
monitoring_and_metrics: Metric: org_policy_changes_total by policy_name and outcome
Metric: policy_enforcement_denied_total with labels: policy_name, reason, org_id
Alert: sudden spike in policy flips (>5 flips/org in 10m) - pager to security on-call
Dashboard: compliance hub showing % orgs with IP allowlist enabled, pending exports, and share-locked count
